question: Which of the following statements concerning extinctive prescription is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: A claim for damages arising from nonperformance of an obligation does not extinguish together with the original claim even if the original claim is extinguished by prescription.
B: The claim concerning work by a person who has undertaken a contract, to which the 3-year short-term extinctive prescription applies, means only the claim for the price of the work, and the contractor’s claim for the establishment of a mortgage, as a claim incidental to that work, does not fall under a claim concerning the work of a person who has undertaken a contract.
C: A junior secured interest holder is a person who directly benefits from the extinction of the secured claim under the senior secured interest, and therefore may invoke the completion of extinctive prescription concerning the secured claim under the senior secured interest.
D: In a lawsuit seeking performance of the procedure for cancellation registration of mortgage establishment registration, brought by a real guarantor on the ground of the nonexistence or extinction of the secured debt, even if the creditor, who is also the mortgagee, prevails by seeking a judgment dismissing the claim and asserting the existence of the secured claim, the creditor’s said act of responding to the lawsuit does not constitute a "judicial claim," which is a ground for interruption of prescription with respect to the secured claim.
E: Where a creditor attaches or provisionally attaches the debtor’s claim against a third-party obligor, the effect of definitive interruption of prescription arises with respect to the debtor’s claim against the third-party obligor.
label: D

question:
A, who operates a moneylending business, lent B a total of KRW 300 million in three transactions as shown in the table below.
Date of Loan Principal Interest Principal Repayment Due Date
2018. 1. 1. KRW 100 million 1% per month (payable on the last day of each month) 2018. 12. 31.
2019. 1. 1. KRW 100 million 1% per month (payable on the last day of each month) 2019. 12. 31.
2020. 7. 1. KRW 100 million 1% per month (payable on the last day of each month) 2021. 6. 30.
Because B has made no repayment whatsoever of the above debts, A intends to file a lawsuit on 2024. 1. 12. seeking payment of the principal of each loan and the interest or late payment damages thereon up to 2023. 12. 31. If B is expected to raise a defense of the extinctive prescription, what is the maximum amount of the claim that A can have upheld in the lawsuit? (However, late payment damages on accrued interest or late payment damages are not claimed, and it is assumed that the last day of the period is not a Saturday or a public holiday. If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
label: C

question: A and B are spouses and have minor children C and D subject to their joint parental authority. Of the explanations concerning this, which is correct? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: If A, despite being contrary to B's intent, performed a juristic act representing C in the joint names of B and A, that juristic act is ineffective regardless of whether the other party acted in good faith.
B: If C entered into a credit card use contract with credit card company E and obtained a card without the consent of A and B, and E paid the price for goods purchased from F using that card, then after A and B rescinded the credit card use contract with E, but did not rescind the sales contract with F and C consumed all of the purchased goods, C does not bear an obligation to return unjust enrichment to E.
C: If, at the time of the juristic act, C merely told the other party that he was an adult and did not actively use deception, C may rescind the above juristic act.
D: After A's death, B, in order to secure the debt of a stock company of which B is the representative director, established a mortgage over the co-owned property of B and C in the capacity of C's legal representative without appointing a special agent, and such act is a conflict-of-interest transaction and therefore void.
E: After A's death, even if B, as the legal representative of C and D, reaches an agreement to divide the inherited property so that all of it becomes D's sole property, such division by agreement is lawful.
label: C

question: A and B entered into a partnership agreement under the Civil Act to conduct a business related to artificial intelligence. Due to personal circumstances, B withdrew from the partnership. Which of the following statements concerning this are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) A partner’s voluntary withdrawal is a kind of termination of the partnership agreement and must be effected by a manifestation of intention to the other partners; however, such manifestation of intention may also be made impliedly. (b) Because B withdrew, the partnership relationship terminated, and as a result the partnership is naturally dissolved or liquidated. (c) Partnership property belonging to the joint ownership of A and B, after B’s withdrawal, belongs to A’s sole ownership. (d) B may demand from A an accounting of the partnership property due to withdrawal, and such accounting must be based on the condition of the partnership property at the time of B’s withdrawal. (e) Unless there are special circumstances, such as a separate agreement regarding the method of calculating the share, when calculating B’s share, A bears the burden of proving the condition of the partnership property.
label: C

question: B, having been granted authority by A to sell X land owned by A, entered into a sales contract with C concerning X land. Which of the following explanations is incorrect? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: If C demanded performance of the obligation from A, but A argues that because he had not granted agency authority to B, he is under no obligation to perform, C must prove that B had authority to sell X land.
B: If B received the balance from the buyer C, then, absent special circumstances, C’s obligation to pay the balance is extinguished even if B did not remit the balance to A.
C: If C was deceived by D, a third party, and entered into the sales contract with B, C may rescind the sales contract on the ground of a manifestation of intent induced by fraud only when B learned of D’s fraudulent conduct.
D: If A argues that the above sales contract was concluded at a price markedly lower than market value and is void as an unfair legal act, the distress requirement is determined based on A, and the rashness/inexperience requirement is determined based on B.
E: Even if adult guardianship is commenced for A after A granted authority to B, B’s agency authority does not terminate.
label: C

question: Which of the following statements concerning acquisitive prescription of possession are correct? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) If X land is in a co-ownership relationship of sectional ownership between B and C, A, who has completed acquisitive prescription with respect to B’s specific sectional ownership portion, may demand performance of the procedure for registration of transfer of ownership on the ground of completion of acquisitive prescription not only against B but also against C, who is unrelated to B’s specific sectional ownership portion, with respect to each co-ownership share in that land portion. (b) Where a person who has lawfully and validly registered and acquired ownership of real property possesses his own real property, unless special circumstances exist, such possession cannot be said to be possession that forms the basis of acquisitive prescription. (c) If A, who has created an assignment by way of security over X land, has possessed X land peacefully and openly with intent to own for 20 years, since acquisition of ownership by acquisitive prescription is an original acquisition, A may seek cancellation of the ownership transfer registration made for security purposes on the ground of acquisitive prescription of possession. (d) If A, the prescriptive acquirer of X land, assigns to C the right to claim registration of transfer of ownership arising from completion of acquisitive prescription, notification by A to B, the registered title holder, of that assignment gives rise to opposability against B.
label: D

question: Which of the following explanations concerning the ancillary clauses of a juristic act is incorrect? (if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: Even if there is an intent to make the arising or extinguishment of the effect of a juristic act depend on whether an uncertain future fact occurs, if such intent is not externally manifested, it cannot constitute a condition as an ancillary clause of the juristic act.
B: The burden of proving that a certain juristic act falls under a juristic act subject to a suspensive condition lies with the person who seeks to assert that the legal effect arising from that juristic act has not occurred.
C: The phrase “when the fulfillment of a condition has been hindered” refers to a case in which, in light of social common sense, the condition would have been fulfilled had there been no hindering act by one party, but it was not fulfilled because of the hindering act; this includes even cases in which the possibility of fulfillment of the condition was markedly low even if there had been no such hindering act.
D: If, after completing the registration of a transfer of ownership of real property due to a gift subject to a resolutory condition, the resolutory condition is fulfilled, ownership reverts to the donor. In such a case, acts of disposition made by the donee before the fulfillment of the condition are void to the extent that they limit the effect of the fulfillment of the condition; however, if that condition has not been registered, the donee may not assert such voidness against a third party who acquired rights through the disposition act.
E: If the parties have designated the time when an uncertain fact occurs as the time for performance, then the time for performance should be deemed to have arrived not only when that fact occurs, but also when the occurrence of that fact has become impossible.
label: C

question: Which of the following statements concerning a physician’s duty to explain are incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) A physician’s duty to explain, for the purpose of obtaining the patient’s consent to surgery, etc., cannot be exempted solely on the ground that the likelihood of adverse sequelae or side effects accompanying the medical act is slight; if such sequelae or side effects are risks that typically arise from the relevant treatment act or are serious and irreversible, they are subject to explanation notwithstanding the slightness of the likelihood of their occurrence. (b) The burden of proof as to a physician’s breach of the duty to explain lies with the patient side, absent special circumstances. (c) A physician’s duty to explain must be performed with sufficient temporal margin before the medical act is carried out. (d) Even if a patient is a minor and has decision-making capacity, it is difficult to regard the patient as having a right of self-determination even with respect to medical acts that expose the patient’s own body to risk; accordingly, in principle, a physician does not bear a duty to explain medical acts to a minor patient.
label: D

question: Among the explanations concerning defective declarations of intent, which is correct? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: In a non-genuine declaration of intent, “true intention” means the matter that the declarant genuinely wishes in his or her mind; therefore, if, at the time the declarant made a declaration of intent to make a gift under duress, the declarant’s true thought was latent in his or her mind that property would be forcibly taken away, then the gift declaration of intent lacks the internal intent to produce the effect of a gift and thus constitutes a non-genuine declaration of intent.
B: Where an act of contribution by written instrument is made for the establishment of a foundation juristic person, even if the juristic person is established and the contributed property becomes basic property, the act of contribution may be rescinded on the ground that it is a declaration of intent based on mistake.
C: In a real estate sale contract, if both the parties, A and B, intended land A to be the object of the contract, but made a mistake as to the lot number, etc. of that object and indicated the object as land B in the contract, then under normative interpretation the sale contract should first be regarded as having been concluded with respect to land B; however, seller A may rescind the above sale contract on the ground of mistake.
D: After A assigned to C a claim for return of lease deposit against B, creditor D of C obtained an order of seizure and collection with respect to the above claim for return of lease deposit, and if the assignment contract for the claim for return of lease deposit is a collusive false declaration of intent and therefore void, then because D is merely a person who acquired the collection right concerning the above claim for return of lease deposit, B may assert against D that the above assignment contract is a collusive false declaration of intent and therefore void, regardless of whether D acted in good faith with respect to the collusive false declaration of intent.
E: If, under the mistaken belief that, if a restitution lawsuit is brought, the real property would have to be returned without receiving any compensation, one enters into a sale contract to sell it, this is merely a mistake as to motive; therefore, only if there is an agreement to make that motive part of the contents of the declaration of intent may the seller rescind the above sale contract on the ground of mistake.
label: B

question: Which of the following statements concerning an order for registration of a leasehold right are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) A tenant who has registered a leasehold right pursuant to an order for registration of a leasehold right, where such leasehold right registration was completed before the registration of the first order to commence auction, falls within the class of creditors entitled to distribution even if he or she does not separately file a demand for distribution. (b) Under the Housing Lease Protection Act, the landlord’s obligation to return the lease deposit is an obligation that must be performed before the tenant’s obligation to cancel the leasehold right registration. (c) Since the Housing Lease Protection Act partially applies mutatis mutandis the procedural provisions concerning provisional seizure under the Civil Execution Act to judicial proceedings on an application for an order for registration of a leasehold right and to the enforcement, etc. of an order for registration of a leasehold right, leasehold right registration pursuant to an order for registration of a leasehold right prescribed by the Housing Lease Protection Act has the effect of interrupting the statute of limitations equivalent to seizure, provisional seizure, or provisional disposition, which are grounds for interruption of the statute of limitations.
label: C

question: Which of the following statements concerning simultaneous performance is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: In a contract for work, where the contractor’s failure to properly perform the obligations under the contract causes damage to the body or property of the employer, the contractor’s damages obligation arising from such consequential damage and the employer’s obligation to pay the construction price are not in a simultaneous performance relationship.
B: An obligation to cancel a transfer registration of ownership in the name of the creditor, or a provisional registration for the preservation of the claim therefor, which was completed for the purpose of securing a secured claim, is in a simultaneous performance relationship with payment of the secured claim.
C: Where a foreclosure auction for the execution of a mortgage is rendered void and Creditor A, who is the mortgagee, exercises, on behalf of Debtor C, the right to claim cancellation of the transfer registration of ownership against successful bidder B, A’s obligation to return the distribution money and B’s obligation to cancel the transfer registration of ownership are in a simultaneous performance relationship.
D: An employer who has assumed the contractor’s obligation to pay the construction price to a subcontractor may oppose the subcontractor’s claim for the construction price with a defense of simultaneous performance based on the contractor’s right to claim repair of defects against the subcontractor.
E: In a lease of a commercial building, the tenant’s obligation to return the leased object and the landlord’s obligation to compensate for damages arising from interference with the recovery of premium are not only based on the same cause, namely the termination of the lease contract, but even from the perspective of fairness, a connection in performance can be recognized.
label: D

question: A had, with his de facto spouse B, an adult child C whom A had acknowledged, and C has a child D born during marriage. A, after being treated for a chronic illness for a long time, died on 2022. 10. 1. At the time of death, A had a loan claim against A, real property X, and a debt for the price of goods to B. Which of the following is incorrect with respect to this? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: Even if B cared for A during A’s illness to the extent of special support beyond the primary duty of support required between spouses, B cannot claim a contributory share under Article 1008-2(1) of the Civil Act.
B: If C filed a declaration renouncing inheritance on 2022. 10. 20, and before being notified of the judicial decision accepting the renunciation declaration C collects and receives payment from A of the above loan claim, it is deemed a simple acceptance.
C: If C filed a declaration renouncing inheritance on 2022. 10. 20, then from that time until before being notified of the judicial decision accepting the renunciation declaration, C bears the duty to manage real property X with the care of a good manager.
D: If B obtained an order of provisional seizure against C regarding real property X on 2022. 10. 12, and as execution thereof a provisional seizure registration was completed on the 13th of the same month, and thereafter C was notified of the judicial decision accepting the renunciation declaration on 2022. 10. 24, B may receive a distribution as a provisional seizure creditor in an auction proceeding for real property X lawfully conducted thereafter.
E: If A had a lawful spouse E who had been living separately for a long time, and after A’s death C filed with the Family Court a declaration renouncing inheritance that satisfied the legal requirements, then E becomes the sole heir.
label: C

question: A and B jointly own Building X in shares of 1/2 each. Building X was constructed on Land Y owned by C. Which of the following statements is incorrect? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: Absent special circumstances, A may claim damages or restitution of unjust enrichment only against the unlawful possessor of Building X, within the extent of A’s share.
B: Even if A exclusively uses Building X, B cannot demand delivery of Building X from A.
C: If Building X was constructed without authorization on Land Y, C may claim demolition of Building X against A, who is exclusively in possession of Building X, within the extent of A’s share, but may not claim that A vacate Building X.
D: If A and B agreed to use Building X alternately for one week at a time, absent special circumstances, that agreement is succeeded to by the specific successor C who acquired B’s share.
E: If A concluded a repair construction contract with D and E for the repair of Building X, and A does not pay the construction price, D and E may claim against B restitution of the construction price as unjust enrichment within the extent of B’s share.
label: E

question: A entered into a sales contract on 2020. 2. 10. with B concerning X real estate owned by B, and on 2020. 3. 10., while paying B the entire purchase price, simultaneously had the registration of transfer of ownership made directly from B to C in C's name pursuant to a title trust agreement between A and his friend C. Which of the following statements based on these facts is incorrect? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: The agreement between A and C and the registration of transfer of ownership in C's name resulting therefrom are void, but A cannot seek registration of transfer of ownership of X real estate against C on the ground of restitution of unjust enrichment.
B: Where A entered into a sales contract with A concerning X real estate and, based thereon, had the registration of transfer of ownership made directly from C to A, such registration, absent special circumstances, is a registration conforming to the substantive legal relationship and is valid.
C: Where creditor B with a monetary claim against C applied for a provisional seizure against X real estate with his monetary claim as the preserved right and the provisional seizure registration was completed, B's provisional seizure is valid.
D: If C, on his own, entered into a sales contract concerning X real estate with C, who knew the agreement between A and C, and, simultaneously with receiving the purchase price, completed the registration of transfer of ownership to C, C may bear liability to A for damages under Article 750 of the Civil Act.
E: If C, on his own, established in favor of his creditor D a mortgage by way of security in D's name concerning X real estate, C obtained a benefit equivalent to the amount of the secured obligation under the mortgage by way of security, and thereby B suffered a loss from infringement of ownership, C bears a duty to return unjust enrichment to B.
label: E

question: Among the explanations concerning inheritance, which is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: If a predeceased person received a house as a gift from the decedent before the occurrence of the cause for representation, that benefit may be regarded as the special benefit of the heir by representation.
B: If a person disqualified from inheritance received a gift from the decedent after grounds for disqualification from inheritance arose, then, absent special circumstances, that benefit does not constitute the special benefit of the heir by representation arising from inheritance disqualification.
C: A coheir who received a special benefit exceeding the value of the statutory share of inheritance must return the excess when the inherited estate is divided.
D: If no agreement is reached among the coheirs, unless there are special circumstances under which the status of the person presiding over ancestral rites cannot be recognized, the eldest among the decedent's lineal descendants, regardless of sex or whether legitimate or illegitimate, who is nearest in degree, becomes the person presiding over ancestral rites.
E: If the decedent, by an act inter vivos or by will, disposed of his or her body and remains or designated a burial place, the person presiding over ancestral rites cannot be said to bear even a legal duty to be unconditionally bound by such intent of the decedent.
label: C

question: Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (×) regarding the right to claim the substitute? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) If, due to expropriation of the object of sale, the seller's duty to register the transfer of ownership has become impossible to perform, the statute of limitations for the right to claim the substitute runs from the time performance became impossible, even if the method and procedure for claiming compensation due to the expropriation were not established until after a considerable period had elapsed thereafter. (b) A obtained a final judgment in a lawsuit against B seeking revocation of a fraudulent act and, by return of the original property, cancellation of the registration of creation of a mortgage. Thereafter, the relevant real property was sold to a third party at auction, thereby making impossible B's duty, under the final judgment, to cancel the registration of creation of the mortgage. In this case, A may exercise the right to claim the substitute and demand the return of the dividends received by B on the basis of the above mortgage. (c) Where the object of sale is expropriated before registration of the transfer of ownership under the sale, a purchaser's claim against the seller seeking a declaration that the right to claim expropriation compensation belongs to the purchaser is a claim concerning the attribution of a claim, in which two or more persons assert that they are creditors with respect to one claim, and thus there is a legal interest in seeking such a declaration.
label: E

question: A entered into a contract with B on 2023. 2. 1. to sell B real property X owned by A for KRW 100,000,000, and received KRW 10,000,000 as a down payment from B on the day of the contract. Under the written contract, the due date for payment of the intermediate payment of KRW 30,000,000 is 2023. 5. 1., and the due date for payment of the balance of KRW 60,000,000 is 2023. 8. 1., each set as follows, and the contract includes the following content. Article △△ (Rescission of Contract) If the buyer fails to pay the intermediate payment on the agreed date, the contract is automatically rescinded. In this case, the buyer may not claim return of the down payment paid. If, due to the seller's intentional act or negligence, the buyer is unable to acquire ownership of real property X and the buyer rescinds the contract, the seller shall return the money received from the buyer by adding interest at 10% per annum from the date of receipt until the time of rescission. Which of the following statements are all correct? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) If B failed to pay the intermediate payment to A by 2023. 5. 1., then unless special circumstances exist, the contract is rescinded without a separate demand or expression of intent to rescind, and B may not claim return of the down payment paid. (b) Even if the above contract was rescinded pursuant to Article △△, Paragraph 1, if A and B continued discussions on the premise that the contract remained valid and A urged performance according to the contract without asserting the legal effects of rescission, then unless special circumstances exist, it is appropriate to regard that there was an agreement between A and B to revive the rescinded contract. (c) If B rescinded the above contract pursuant to Article △△, Paragraph 2, and claimed return of the money paid to A and payment of interest thereon, and A delayed performance thereof, then unless special circumstances exist, the delay damages therefrom must be calculated at the rate of 10% per annum. (d) If A and B agreed to rescind the contract irrespective of the above contractual clause, and there was no separate agreement on interest to be added to the money to be returned due to the consensual rescission, then the money paid by B must be returned with interest at 10% per annum from the date of payment.
label: D

question: Which of the following statements concerning monetary claims and liability for delay thereon is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: If the creditor of a loan for consumption, through intent or negligence, receives interest exceeding the maximum interest rate under the Interest Limitation Act, and if, after the excess portion is appropriated to the principal, there remains an amount even after the principal has been fully extinguished, then, absent special circumstances, tort liability arises for the creditor with respect to that portion.
B: If an order of assignment for all of a part of a monetary claim becomes final and conclusive, a set-off by a third-party debtor, who holds a counterclaim against the debtor subject to seizure with respect to that claim, must be exercised in accordance with the respective proportions of the amount of the claim assigned in full and the amount of the claim not assigned in full, relative to the total amount of the claim.
C: Unless there is a separate agreement concerning the overdue interest rate on a surety obligation, the overdue interest rate agreed upon for the principal obligation applies to the surety obligation.
D: Where the time for performance is set as an uncertain due date, the debtor becomes liable for delay in performance from the time the due date arrives.
E: If damage arises due to the tort of the person guaranteed, the identity guarantor bears liability for delay with respect to the identity guarantee obligation from the time of the person guaranteed’s tort.
label: A

question: A entered into a construction contract with B, a construction contractor, in order to newly construct Building Y on A’s land X. In order to enable B to obtain a loan from C using land X as security and to expend the construction costs, A established on land X a mortgage with C as the mortgagee and B as the debtor, and B used the money borrowed from C as the construction price. During the progress of the construction, D, a creditor of B, obtained an order of seizure and assignment for part of B’s claim for the construction price against A, and the order became final as it stood. Thereafter, even though the construction was completed, B was unable to repay the loan to C, so A, by subrogation for B, paid C the principal of the loan and the overdue interest. Among the following explanations, which are all correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) When the order of assignment was served on A, retroactively, a divisible claim is established between D and B with respect to the portion of the claim that was assigned in full and the portion of the claim that was not assigned in full. (b) B’s obligation to deliver Building Y is in a concurrent-performance relationship with A’s debt to pay the construction price, but B’s obligation to cancel the mortgage on land X is not an obligation having an inherent quid pro quo relationship under the above construction contract for work, so a performance-connected relationship with A’s debt to pay the construction price cannot be recognized. (c) B’s reimbursement debt arising from A’s subrogated payment is, as a transformed form of B’s obligation to cancel the mortgage on land X, in a concurrent-performance relationship with A’s debt to pay the construction price within the extent of the equal amount. (d) If, in response to D’s claim for the assigned amount, A raises a set-off defense using A’s reimbursement claim against B, A cannot oppose D by set-off based on the above reimbursement claim because A’s active claim, namely A’s reimbursement claim against B, arose after D’s seizure order was served on A.
label: B

question: A entered into a loan agreement with B on 2020. 8. 11., and, in order to secure A's claim against B, established a mortgage with a maximum secured amount of KRW 1.2 billion on land X owned by B. At B's request, C and D entered into a joint surety agreement with A. When B failed to repay the above debt, A filed an application for a voluntary auction based on the above mortgage over land X on 2023. 1. 23., and at the time of the auction application, A's claim against B amounted to KRW 1.2 billion. During the auction proceedings, C repaid KRW 400 million to A, and D repaid KRW 200 million to A, and accordingly received a registration of transfer of part of the mortgage from A. After filing the auction application, A additionally lent KRW 300 million to B on 2023. 5. 12., and in the auction proceedings, E purchased land X for KRW 900 million and paid the purchase price in full on 2023. 8. 18. Which combination of amounts to be distributed to A, C, and D in the above auction proceedings is correct? (Interest, delayed damages, and execution costs are not considered. If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) The amounts in the following choices mean, in order, the respective amounts for A, C, and D.
A: KRW 300 million, KRW 400 million, KRW 200 million
B: KRW 450 million, KRW 300 million, KRW 150 million
C: KRW 540 million, KRW 240 million, KRW 120 million
D: KRW 600 million, KRW 200 million, KRW 100 million
E: KRW 900 million, KRW 0, KRW 0
label: D

question: Which of the following statements concerning the extinction of claims are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) During the continuance of the lease, if the statute of limitations for the rent claim has expired, the lessor may not set it off against the obligation to return the lease deposit by using it as the active claim; however, by analogical application of Article 495 of the Civil Act, the overdue rent may be deducted from the lease deposit. (b) Even where, due to special circumstances such as there being no risk of impairing the stability of the worker's economic life, the employer may set off against the worker's wage claim by using the employer's claim for restitution of unjust enrichment arising from overpaid wages, such set-off by the employer is permitted only with respect to the portion exceeding one-half of the wage claim. (c) Where the assignee of a claim set off the assigned claim, as the active claim, against an existing claim that the debtor had against the assignee, even if the due date for performance of both claims had already arrived before the assignment of the claim, the effect of the set-off retroacts not to the due date but to the time when the requirements for opposability of the assignment of the claim were satisfied. (d) If the statute of limitations for the loan claim that the lessor held against the lessee expired during the continuance of the lease, the lessor may not set off the lessee's claim for reimbursement of beneficial expenses against the lessor by using the above claim as the active claim.
label: E

question: Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are true (○) and false (×) regarding obligations involving multiple parties? (Interest and delay damages are not considered. If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) Where one of the joint and several debtors is released from part of the debt, if the remaining amount that the joint and several debtor must pay exceeds the share of burden, the other joint and several debtor must bear the entire debt. (b) In a cumulative assumption of debt, the obligor and the assumer are, in principle, in a quasi-joint and several liability relationship. (c) If a creditor files an auction application against real property owned by one of the joint and several debtors and, within 6 months thereafter, brings a judicial claim against another joint and several debtor, the extinctive prescription of the claim against that other joint and several debtor is interrupted as of the time of the auction application, and the interrupted prescription begins anew from the termination of the said auction proceedings. (d) A, B, and C caused D damage in the amount of KRW 9 million through a joint tort. Internally, A was without negligence, and the degree of negligence of B and C was equal. If A compensated D for the full KRW 9 million, A may demand performance of the recourse obligation of KRW 9 million against B.
label: C

question: Which of the following statements regarding the duty of support are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) Because the duty of support between spouses is intended to make it possible to maintain the spouses’ common life, if the marriage has irretrievably broken down and the spouses are living separately while filing divorce actions against each other, then unless there are special circumstances, the duty of support between the spouses should be deemed extinguished even before the divorce is finalized. (b) With respect to past maintenance among spouses, unless there are special circumstances, the person entitled to support may claim payment only for the period after the obligor fell into delay by failing to perform the duty of support despite a demand for performance of that duty. (c) If one spouse refuses cohabitation without just cause, then unless there are special circumstances such as the other spouse’s claim for cohabitation constituting an abuse of rights, that spouse cannot claim payment of maintenance from the other party. (d) The right of one spouse who has raised the child alone to seek payment of past child-rearing expenses from the other spouse does not run under the Statute of Limitations until, through an agreement of the parties or a family court adjudication, etc., it has become a concrete claim for payment.
label: D

question: A and B entered into a contract under which B would purchase land X owned by A, and agreed that the purchase price would be paid simultaneously with the delivery of land X and the completion of registration of transfer of ownership. C provided a joint and several suretyship for B’s obligation to pay the purchase price to A under the above sales contract. Which of the following statements are incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) After B pays A the full purchase price, if B assigns the claim for registration of transfer of ownership to D and B notifies A thereof, D may directly demand A’s performance of the procedure for registration of transfer of ownership. (b) A assigned to D the claim for the purchase price against B while explaining the content of the above contract and the fact that registration of transfer of ownership for land X had not yet been completed, and on the same day B gave assent to the assignment of claim without reservation of objection. Thereafter, if D demands B to pay the assigned amount, B cannot refuse D’s demand on the ground that A had not tendered performance of the obligation to register transfer of ownership. (c) Even if A assigned the claim for the purchase price against B to D and notified B thereof by an instrument bearing a fixed date, if A later assigned the claim against B again to E, then after A and D rescinded by agreement the assignment contract between them and D notified B of the rescission by agreement, E acquires the claim for the purchase price against B absent special circumstances. (d) If A assigns the claim for the purchase price against B to D and notifies B thereof, then absent special circumstances not only the claim against B but also the claim against C is transferred to D together. (e) Although A and B agreed in the sales contract not to assign the claim, A assigned the claim for the purchase price to D, who knew of such agreement, and notified B thereof, and thereafter D again assigned the claim for the purchase price to E, who did not know of the agreement between A and B, and notified B thereof, B cannot assert against E the existence of the special agreement prohibiting assignment of claims.
label: A

question: A has, against B, a matured loan claim in the amount of KRW 200 million (Claim A), and B, who is in an over-indebted state, has, against C, a matured loan claim in the amount of KRW 200 million (Claim B), and B made a gift of the X real property owned by B to D. Which of the following explanations is incorrect? (Each statement is independent, and If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: A may, in order to preserve Claim A, bring an action, by subrogating to B, against C seeking that C pay Claim B directly to A, and if, after the judgment became final and conclusive, A’s creditor E obtained an order of seizure and an order of assignment with respect to such claim of A against C for payment, then both the seizure order and the assignment order are void.
B: Where A, without seeking payment of Claim A against B, brings a creditor’s subrogation action against C seeking payment of Claim B on the basis of Claim A as the preserved claim, C may contest by asserting that Claim A was extinguished by performance, but C may not oppose A by asserting that Claim A was extinguished by prescription.
C: If, after B became aware that A had exercised the creditor’s subrogation right against C, during the pendency of the creditor’s subrogation action an order of seizure and an order of assignment were made with respect to Claim B upon the application of F, another creditor of B, then the order of assignment with respect to Claim B is void unless special circumstances exist, but the order of seizure is valid, so the above creditor’s subrogation action by A against C is dismissed.
D: Where A has, pursuant to an action to revoke a fraudulent act, a claim for compensation of value against D, it is not permissible for D to assert set-off against A on the ground that D has a claim against B and thereby refuse to pay the apportioned amount corresponding to D’s own claim out of the total amount of the claims.
E: If A, using Claim A as the preserved claim, filed an action for revocation of a fraudulent act against D within the preclusive period, and after the preclusive period had expired changed the preserved claim to a claim for return of unjust enrichment against B, this does not constitute an exchange amendment of the action, so the above action for revocation of a fraudulent act is lawful.
label: C

question: A granted a jeonse right over building X, which A owns, in favor of B. Which of the following statements are incorrect? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) After B granted a mortgage over the jeonse right for the benefit of B’s creditor C, if A lent money to B without fixing a maturity date, and if, after the expiration of the term of the jeonse right, C attached B’s claim for return of the jeonse deposit by way of real subrogation, A may assert setoff of the loan claim against the claim for return of the jeonse deposit against C. (b) If B granted a mortgage over the jeonse right for the benefit of B’s creditor C, and after the expiration of the term of the jeonse right, B’s general creditor D provisionally attached the claim for return of the jeonse deposit, and then C obtained an attachment and an order of transfer over B’s claim for return of the jeonse deposit by way of real subrogation, C cannot demand payment of the jeonse deposit from A. (c) B’s jeonse right was established for the purpose of securing a claim for return of a lease deposit under a lease agreement. If B granted a mortgage over the jeonse right for the benefit of B’s creditor C, knowing this circumstance, A may assert against C, who exercises the right of real subrogation, a defense of deduction of overdue rent under the lease agreement. (d) After the term had expired, if B assigned the claim for return of the jeonse deposit together with the jeonse right and made supplementary registration in the name of the transferee E, the priority between E and the creditor who attached the claim for return of the jeonse deposit and obtained an order of transfer is determined according to whether the time of the supplementary registration precedes or follows the time of attachment.
label: E

question: A lent B 100,000,000 won to B on 2015. 2. 1., setting the due date as 2016. 1. 31., but B, without having repaid the loan at all, sold X land, his only asset, worth approximately 300,000,000 won, to C on 2021. 4. 1., and transferred title registration the following day. On 20232. 2. 21., A filed a lawsuit against C with the following prayer for relief, and the court of first instance rendered a judgment in the operative part below. [Prayer for Relief] 1. The sales contract concluded on 2021. 4. 1. between Defendant and B concerning X land is revoked. 2. Defendant shall comply with the procedure for cancellation registration of the ownership transfer registration completed with Receipt No. 1234, received at the Registry Office of the Seoul Central District Court on 2021. 4. 2., concerning the land described in paragraph 1, in favor of B. 3. Litigation costs shall be borne by Defendant. 4. Paragraph 2 may be provisionally executed. [Operative Part] 1. The sales contract concluded on 2021. 4. 1. between Defendant and B concerning X land is revoked within the limit of 100,000,000 won. 2. Defendant shall pay 100,000,000 won to Plaintiff. 3. The remainder of Plaintiff's claim is dismissed. 4. Litigation costs shall be borne by Defendant. 5. Paragraph 2 may be provisionally executed. Which of the following statements are all correct? (Assume that there was no change in the market value of X land, and interest and delay damages are not considered. Each statement is independent, and If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)(a) If the mortgage on land X (secured claim amount: KRW 100 million), established on March 15, 2020, was extinguished on May 1, 2021, it is proper for the court to render a judgment as stated in Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the disposition without any amendment to the claims. (b) It is proper for the court to declare provisional execution as stated in Paragraph 5 of the disposition. (c) If A, while amending the claim to seek payment of KRW 100 million as stated in Paragraph 2 of the disposition, also claimed damages for delay at the rate of 12% per annum pursuant to the Act on Special Cases Concerning Expedition, etc. of Legal Proceedings, the court may render a judgment in Paragraph 2 ordering damages for delay at the rate of 12% per annum. (d) If A is a bank and C raises a defense of extinctive prescription against A’s loan claim, the court would have rendered a judgment dismissing A’s claim in its entirety. (e) An attachment and assignment order obtained with respect to the monetary compensation claim stated in Paragraph 2 of the disposition, using a monetary claim held by C against A as the enforcement claim, is void.
label: A

question: A entered into a pledge agreement with C, for the purpose of securing A’s monetary debt to C, with respect to A’s claim for return of the lease deposit against B, and notified B of this fact by an instrument bearing a certified date. Which of the following is the correct combination of the true statement (○) and the false statement (×)? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) If A establishes a pledge in favor of C with respect to a lease deposit return claim secured by a mortgage, and the additional registration of the pledge does not separately state the claim’s delay damages, then this is not included in the scope of the secured claim under the mortgage-backed pledge. (b) Even if B, without C’s consent, set off a claim against A against the lease deposit return claim and thereby extinguished it, C may still directly demand performance of the debt from B. (c) If, with respect to A’s lease deposit return claim, an attachment and assignment order was issued upon the application of D, A’s general creditor, and if C had satisfied the opposability requirements by an instrument bearing a certified date before the day on which the order was served on B, then B may not oppose C on the ground that B paid D. (d) If, after A had granted a pledge to C, a mortgage was established on real property owned by B in order to secure A’s lease deposit return claim, unless C made an additional registration of the pledge in the registration of the above mortgage, the effect of the pledge does not extend to the mortgage.
label: D

question: Which of the following is the correct combination of the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (×) regarding statutory superficies in X land? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) After A established a mortgage in B’s name with respect to X land owned by A, A constructed a Y building on X land with B’s consent. If the mortgage is enforced and C acquires ownership of X land, A acquires a statutory superficies under Article 366 of the Civil Act. (b) After C, A’s creditor, provisionally attached the Y building owned by A on X land owned by B, B acquired ownership of the Y building. If principal seizure and compulsory auction proceedings based on the above provisional attachment proceed and D acquires ownership of the Y building, D acquires a customary superficies. (c) A, after making a provisional registration in B’s name in order to secure a claim against B with respect to X land owned by A, thereafter constructed a Y building on X land. If B later completes the principal registration based on the above provisional registration, A does not acquire a customary superficies. (d) Where A and B co-owned X land and Y building in equal 1/2 shares, and A donated his co-ownership share in the Y building to C, C acquires a customary superficies.
label: E

question: Which of the following explanations concerning the creditor's avoidance action is incorrect? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: Where, after ownership of real property has been transferred by a fraudulent act, a third party acquires rights such as a mortgage or superficies over the real property, the creditor may claim against the beneficiary avoidance of the fraudulent act and performance of the procedure for registration of transfer of ownership to the debtor.
B: Where A, around July 2023, title-trusted X real property, which was A's only asset, to his spouse B; and A, on the premise of terminating the said title-trust agreement, sold X real property to C, and by agreement among A, B, and C, completed registration of transfer of ownership from B directly to C, the sale between A and C may constitute a fraudulent act harming A's general creditors.
C: An act by which a debtor, with respect to real property that is his only asset, newly enters into a sale reservation in order to extend the peremptory period when the expiration of the peremptory period for the right to complete the reservation under the sale reservation is imminent may constitute a fraudulent act subject to the creditor's avoidance action.
D: Where, after a fraudulent act has occurred, a creditor, knowing that there is a ground for avoidance, assigns the claim to be preserved, and the assignee exercises the creditor's avoidance action to preserve that claim, whether the peremptory period has elapsed should be determined based on the day on which the assignor of that claim became aware of the ground for avoidance.
E: Where B, pursuant to a title-trust agreement concluded around July 2023 with his friend A, concluded a sales contract for X real property with C, the owner of X real property who did not know of the title trust, and after registration of transfer of ownership was effected in B's name, A, who was in a state of insolvency, became the de facto party and sold X real property to a third party, then A's act of sale becomes a fraudulent act against A's general creditors.
label: E

question: Which of the following statements regarding parent-child relationships is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: Even if a conciliation or judicial settlement containing a statement confirming that there is no natural parent-child relationship between the parties is concluded, it has no effect.
B: Even a relative prescribed in Article 777 of the Civil Act is recognized as having standing as a plaintiff in an action to confirm the existence or nonexistence of a natural parent-child relationship only when that person qualifies as an interested party prescribed in Article 865 of the Civil Act.
C: Where, after co-heirs B and C of the decedent A (female) have already divided or disposed of the inherited property, it is clearly revealed by a final and conclusive judgment confirming the existence of a natural parent-child relationship that D is A’s child, the proviso to Article 860 of the Civil Act concerning the limitation on the retroactive effect of acknowledgment does not apply, and therefore D cannot deny the validity of the division or disposition made by B and C.
D: Where a child born through artificial insemination is born between a husband and wife who are living a normal marital life, the child born through artificial insemination is presumed to be the husband’s child, and if the husband later retracts his consent to the artificial insemination and files an action to disavow paternity, such action is not permitted.
E: A gender correction must not be denied merely on the ground that a transgender person has a minor child, without making a substantive determination by considering various circumstances for balancing legal interests so as to harmonize the protection of the transgender person’s fundamental rights with the protection and welfare of the minor child.
label: C

question: A, who operates a furniture manufacturing business, received lumber worth 10,000,000 won from B, a raw materials supplier, and delivered to B the following promissory note. Which of the following statements is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) <FRONT> Promissory Note To A Amount: 10,000,000 won I will pay the above amount to you or your order against this promissory note. Due date: 2023. 12. 5. Date of issue: 2023. 5. 1. Place of payment: 105, Sunae-dong, Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si Issuer: C (Jonghyeon Sofa) Place of payment: Hyochang Bank Co., Ltd., Sunae-dong Branch <BACK> Please pay the amount stated on the front to B or B's order. Protest waived. 2023. 6. 20. Address: 123, Hadan 1-dong, Saha-gu, Busan Name: A (Gyeongjin Furniture)
A: Unless there are special circumstances, A is presumed to have delivered the promissory note to B for payment to B.
B: A may, in principle, raise a defense of simultaneous performance that he will pay against the note when B demands payment of the lumber price; however, if the rights under the note have been extinguished by the expiration of the statute of limitations and A faces no risk of double payment and also cannot exercise rights against the other obligor on the note, the right to assert the defense of simultaneous performance is denied.
C: B may first exercise the claim on the note, and only when satisfaction cannot be obtained thereby may B exercise the claim for the price of the lumber against A.
D: If, because B did not take the necessary measures to interrupt the statute of limitations, the statute of limitations for the rights under the note has expired, and if A, after receiving the note back, can obtain satisfaction of his own underlying claim against C by exercising that claim, A cannot exercise a claim for damages against B.
E: If C issued the above promissory note to A for payment of the furniture price, and thereafter the furniture sale contract was rescinded, C may assert this against B's claim for payment on the note.
label: E

question: B created a joint mortgage on B-owned X land (market value KRW 120,000,000) and on Y land owned by the real guarantor C (market value KRW 80,000,000) in order to secure B’s debt of KRW 100,000,000 to A. D acquired a second mortgage right on X land (secured claim: KRW 10,000,000), and E acquired a second mortgage right on Y land (secured claim: KRW 40,000,000). Which of the following correctly combines the true statements (○) and the false statements (×) concerning this matter? (Do not consider interest, delay damages, or execution costs. Each statement is independent, and  if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) If X land is first sold by auction and A receives payment in full from the sale proceeds (KRW 100,000,000), then when Y land is sold by auction, D can receive KRW 10,000,000 from the sale proceeds of Y land (KRW 80,000,000). (b) If Y land is first sold by auction and the entire sale proceeds (KRW 80,000,000) are distributed to A, then B may assert against E by setting off the KRW 50,000,000 matured loan claim that B holds against C against the reimbursement claim that C acquired against B. (c) If B sells X land to F and completes the registration of transfer of ownership, and thereafter B’s general creditor A (claim amount: KRW 100,000,000) has the above sale contract rescinded as a fraudulent act and must provide value compensation, then if there is no change in the market values of X land and Y land, the scope of value compensation is KRW 20,000,000.
label: E

question: Which of the following statements regarding the legal relationship between A, who operates an inn, and B, the guest of the inn, are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) The lodging contract concluded between A and B constitutes a type of lease agreement for temporary use of a guest room. (b) In order for a bailment relationship to be established between A and B, there must be an express or implied agreement between them that A will assume an obligation to keep the object within his sphere of control. (c) Even if A has not taken the item in bailment from B, A is liable to compensate for damages when an item carried into the facility is lost or damaged due to A’s own negligence or that of his employee. (d) If A controls entry to the inn’s attached parking lot or, without confirming the fact of parking, merely provides a parking space, then even if B parked the vehicle in the parking lot and entrusted the vehicle’s custody by leaving the vehicle key at the inn, an agreement of bailment between A and B cannot be recognized. (e) If B dies due to a fire at the inn, C, B’s spouse, may claim from A damages for his or her own emotional distress on the ground of A’s breach of the lodging contract with B.
label: B

question: Company A entered into a contract to transfer its hotel business to Company B. Although Company B did not assume Company A’s debts, it neither registered that it was not liable for Company A’s debts nor notified Company A’s creditors to that effect. After acquiring the business, Company B carried on the same hotel business and continued to use, unchanged, the business establishment name “△△Jeju” that Company A had used. Which of the following statements concerning this is incorrect? ( If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: If a business is transferred comprehensively, then, unless otherwise stipulated, the employment relationship between Company A and its employees is also comprehensively succeeded to by Company B as a general rule.
B: Even when the designation continued to be used by Company B is not the trade name itself but a house name or business sign, Company B shall, unless special circumstances exist, bear the debt by analogical application of Commercial Act Article 42 (Liability of a Transferee Who Continues to Use the Trade Name), paragraph 1.
C: Company B’s liability for payment with respect to the claims of third parties arising from Company A’s business is extinguished when 2 years have elapsed after the business transfer.
D: Notwithstanding the business transfer, with respect to creditors of Company A who know that there was no assumption of debts, Company B’s liability does not arise, and Company B bears the burden of allegation and proof as to the fact that the creditor acted in bad faith.
E: If a creditor of Company A did not know, around the time of the business transfer, that there was no assumption of debts, then, unless special circumstances exist, Company B’s liability for payment arises under Commercial Act Article 42, paragraph 1, and even if the creditor later comes to know that there was no assumption of debts, the already-arisen liability for payment of Company B is not extinguished.
label: C

question: Which of the following explanations concerning security by provisional registration is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: Under the Act on Security by Provisional Registration, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “Provisional Registration Security Act”), where an order to commence compulsory auction has been issued with respect to real property for which a security provisional registration has been completed, if the application for auction was made before payment of the liquidation amount (or, where there is no liquidation amount, before the liquidation period has elapsed), the holder of the security provisional registration may not demand the principal registration pursuant to that provisional registration.
B: Where, in violation of the liquidation procedure under the Provisional Registration Security Act, a principal registration based on a security provisional registration has been made, if, in the auction procedure conducted with respect to the real property subject to security, the purchaser acquired ownership by purchasing the real property without knowing that the principal registration was invalid, the debtor may no longer pay the entire amount of the secured obligation to the creditor and request cancellation of that principal registration.
C: Where, after a provisional registration has been made for the purpose of securing both an obligation to repay borrowed money arising from a contract of loan for consumption and an obligation arising from another cause, the latter obligation has been extinguished by payment or other cause and only the obligation to repay borrowed money arising from the contract of loan for consumption remains, the Provisional Registration Security Act does not apply to that security by provisional registration.
D: Where a principal registration completed without going through the liquidation procedure under the Provisional Registration Security Act is void, if the debtor has concluded a lease contract with the creditor concerning the real property subject to security and has paid rent to the creditor, such rent shall, unless special circumstances exist, be deemed to have been appropriated to the satisfaction of the secured obligation.
E: In the private execution of a security right by provisional registration, execution of the security right in a manner whereby the creditor may receive the principal registration and delivery of the secured property before payment of the liquidation amount, or in a manner that does not recognize the liquidation period or the relationship of simultaneous performance, is not permitted under the Provisional Registration Security Act.
label: C

question: B established in favor of A, in order to secure a debt arising from continuing goods transactions with A, a security mortgage with a maximum secured amount of KRW 100,000,000 on X land owned by debtor B. B's friend C established a security mortgage with a maximum secured amount of KRW 100,000,000 on Y building owned by C in order to secure B's above debt. Thereafter, with respect to X land, D acquired a second-ranking mortgage (secured claim: KRW 80,000,000). After the goods transaction ended due to B's default, Y building was first auctioned upon A's application, and at that time A's claim for the price of goods was KRW 110,000,000 (principal KRW 100,000,000, delay damages KRW 10,000,000), and the sale proceeds of KRW 80,000,000 were distributed in full to A (applied to delay damages KRW 10,000,000 and principal KRW 70,000,000). Thereafter, X land was auctioned upon A's application, and at that time A's claim was KRW 35,000,000 (principal KRW 30,000,000, delay damages KRW 5,000,000), and the sale proceeds were KRW 75,000,000. Which of the following statements concerning this are all correct? (Execution costs are not considered. Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a)If the maximum amount mortgages on land X and building Y constitute a joint maximum amount mortgage, A may receive a distribution of KRW 20,000,000 from the sale proceeds of land X. (b) If the maximum amount mortgages on land X and building Y are maximum amount mortgages that cumulatively secure the underlying claim, A may receive a distribution of KRW 35,000,000 from the sale proceeds of land X. (c) If the maximum amount mortgages on land X and building Y are maximum amount mortgages that cumulatively secure the underlying claim, D may receive a distribution of KRW 40,000,000 from the sale proceeds of land X.
label: B

question: Which of the following statements concerning a possessory lien are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) The indivisibility of a possessory lien, under which the lienholder may exercise the right over the entire retained property until payment of the entire claim is received, also applies even where the subject matter is divisible or consists of several items. (b) Where a lienholder who acquired a possessory lien over several parcels of land with one claim as the secured claim violates the duty of care of a good manager with respect to some of those parcels, the claim for extinguishment of the possessory lien may, absent special circumstances, be made only with respect to the parcel on which the violation occurred. (c) Where a person whose possession of a thing has been dispossessed exercises the right to claim damages arising from the extinguishment of the possessory lien, which is the principal right, that person must exercise it within 1 year from the day possession was dispossessed. (d) In auction proceedings for real property owned by a debtor over which a maximum mortgage has been created, if no possessory lien was asserted, and the real property was sold and title was transferred to the purchaser, thereby extinguishing the maximum mortgage, and thereafter there is a person who claims that he or she had a possessory lien even before the seizure, the creditor, as the maximum mortgagee, has a legal interest in seeking confirmation of the nonexistence of the possessory lien. (e) Where there is a special agreement excluding a possessory lien, no possessory lien arises even if all other statutory requirements are satisfied; however, a person who purchased the retained property in the auction proceedings is not a party to the above agreement and therefore cannot assert the effect of the above agreement.
label: A

question: A entered into an insurance contract with Insurance Company A, using his father B as the insured and with B’s death as the insured event. Which of the following statements are correct? [“written form” includes the electronic documents prescribed in Commercial Act Article 731(1) (Insurance on the Life of Another), and If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.] (a) The Commercial Act provision requiring that, in an insurance contract with another person’s death as the insured event, that person’s written consent be obtained at the time the insurance contract is concluded is a mandatory provision. (b) B’s consent must be given in writing individually with respect to the insurance contract, and comprehensive, implied, or presumed consent alone is insufficient. (c) The time by which B must express consent in writing is by the time the insurance contract is concluded. (d) A, who concluded an insurance contract with B’s death as the insured event without B’s written consent, asserting the invalidity on his own, is, absent special circumstances, an exercise of rights contrary to the principle of good faith or the principle of estoppel. (e) If B’s written consent is absent, the insurance contract is void, but if B ratifies it, the insurance contract may become valid.
label: B

question: A entered into a fire insurance contract with A Insurance Company, naming B as the insured, with respect to the bakery owned by his father B, without B's authorization. Although a fire had previously occurred at the bakery, at the time of the insurance contract A entered "No fire has occurred" in the questionnaire on the application form regarding whether a fire had occurred, and A Insurance Company was not negligent in believing this. Among the following explanations, which is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: At the time of concluding the fire insurance contract, A must notify A Insurance Company that he had not been authorized by B.
B: Whether a fire had occurred at the bakery is presumed to be an important fact subject to the duty of disclosure.
C: Even if it is not a question item stated in the questionnaire on the application form, it is not necessarily excluded from the scope of the duty of disclosure.
D: Even if a fire occurs at the bakery after the fire insurance contract is concluded, A Insurance Company may terminate the fire insurance contract on the ground of A's breach of the duty of disclosure only where there is a causal relationship between A's breach of the duty of disclosure and the fire.
E: If A, intentionally or by gross negligence, stated that no fire had occurred, A Insurance Company may terminate the contract only within 1 month from the day it learned of that fact and within 3 years from the day the fire insurance contract was concluded.
label: D

question: A, B, and C were directors of Company A, an unlisted stock company, and D was its auditor. A had acquired shares representing 60% of the total issued shares of Company A and completed the registration of transfer, and was a major shareholder, while B was the representative director of Company A. The articles of incorporation of Company A provide that the remuneration of directors and auditors shall be determined by resolution of the general meeting of shareholders, but B, without a resolution of the general meeting of shareholders, paid a special performance bonus to C in accordance with A's instructions. Which of the following statements concerning this matter are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) The special performance bonus paid to C is included in a director's remuneration as consideration paid for the performance of a director's duties. (b) Even if the special performance bonus paid to C was paid pursuant to A's instructions, unless there are special circumstances, it cannot be regarded as the equivalent of a resolution of the general meeting of shareholders regarding the payment of the special performance bonus. (c) Even if B, who was facing retirement due to loss of management control, etc., established a retirement allowance payment provision that was excessively excessive and markedly departed from a reasonable level in order to receive as much retirement allowance as possible and caused a resolution of the general meeting of shareholders to be adopted despite the opposition of minority shareholders through the exercise of influence by using his position, the resolution is valid, and B may exercise a claim for payment of retirement allowance on the basis of that retirement allowance payment provision. (d) If A, after acquiring all of the total issued shares of Company A and completing the registration of transfer, prepared the minutes of the general meeting of shareholders as if there had been a resolution of the general meeting of shareholders concerning the special performance bonus provision, then even if no actual general meeting of shareholders was held, unless there are special circumstances, it may be regarded as having had a resolution of the general meeting of shareholders concerning that provision. (e) The remuneration of an auditor may be determined only by a provision of the articles of incorporation and cannot be determined by resolution of the general meeting of shareholders, so Company A cannot pay remuneration to D by resolution of the general meeting of shareholders notwithstanding the provision of the articles of incorporation.
label: A

question: Which of the following statements concerning companies under the Commercial Act is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: Even where, in a limited company, the members’ meeting resolves to specify concretely the remuneration amount of a particular director, if the members’ meeting thereafter resolves to reduce that remuneration amount, the remuneration of the relevant director shall, unless there are special circumstances, be reduced in accordance with that resolution.
B: When a person intends to establish a limited liability company, a stock company, or a limited company, an application may be made for provisional registration of the trade name at the registry office having jurisdiction over the location of the principal office.
C: In a limited partnership, a general partner who has been adjudged to have lost the authority to execute business must newly be granted such authority under the articles of incorporation or with the consent of all partners in order to again have the authority to execute business or the authority to represent the partnership.
D: In a general partnership, whether there was intent or negligence in respect of an improper registration shall be determined on the basis of the representative partner.
E: A limited liability company may not acquire all or part of its equity interests, and where it acquires such equity interests, those equity interests shall be extinguished at the time of acquisition.
label: A

question: A issued a promissory note to B for the purpose of facilitating B’s financing, and B endorsed and transferred the note to C in order to discharge B’s debt for the price owed to C. Which of the following statements is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: If B, having satisfied the requirements under the Bills of Exchange and Promissory Notes Act, claims payment of the note amount from A, A may raise the accommodation-note defense.
B: If C, having satisfied the requirements under the Bills of Exchange and Promissory Notes Act, claims payment of the note amount from A, A may not raise the accommodation-note defense, even if C knew that it was an accommodation note.
C: Even if C acquired the note by an endorsement after maturity, A may not raise the accommodation-note defense.
D: If B, after achieving the purpose of facilitating financing, recovered the note from C, but did not return the note to A, cancelled his own endorsement, and then used it again with D, a third party, A may assert against D the defense of re-use of the accommodation note, even if D did not know without negligence that the note was an accommodation note and that it was being used again after having already been used and having fulfilled its purpose.
E: If the maturity date of the note delivered by B to C is later than the due date for payment of the price debt, then, absent special circumstances, C should be deemed to have intended to defer payment of the antecedent debt to B.
label: D

question: A is a non-listed stock company. Its directors are A, B, and C, among whom A is the representative director, and B and C are outside directors. On the shareholder register, out of Company A’s total issued shares, D holds 0.8% of the shares, and E holds 3% of the shares. A violated statutes and regulations in the course of share cancellation for a reduction of stated capital, and as a result, Company A suffered damage. Thereafter, the board of directors of Company A prepared a merger agreement in order to merge with Company B and convened a general meeting of shareholders for approval of the agreement. Shareholder E opposes the merger and seeks to exercise the right to demand the purchase of shares. Which of the following statements is not correct? (Do not consider simplified mergers or small-scale mergers; If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: Company A may claim compensation for the damage against A even before a judgment invalidating the reduction of stated capital becomes final and binding, and A is liable for delay from the time the claim is received.
B: If Company A does not pursue A’s liability, D may, together with E, request Company A to file an action to pursue A’s liability.
C: If B and C, despite there being grounds to suspect that A’s share cancellation act was unlawful, negligently breached their duty of supervision and thereby left it unattended, they are liable to compensate for the damage suffered by Company A as a result.
D: In order for E to demand the purchase of shares, E must notify Company A in writing of its intention to oppose the resolution approving the merger agreement before the general meeting of shareholders for approval of the merger agreement.
E: Even if E exercises the right to demand the purchase of shares and receives payment of the share purchase price from Company A, E may exercise the right to inspect the accounting books against Company A within 2 months from the expiration of the period for demand for purchase.
label: E

question: A Company, which is a non-listed stock company, has a quorum provision in its articles of incorporation stating, “The election of directors shall be by the attendance of shareholders holding shares representing a majority of the total issued shares and by the affirmative vote of a majority of the voting rights of the shareholders present.” However, there is no separate provision regarding cumulative voting. Shareholder A, who holds shares equal to 5% of the total issued shares excluding shares without voting rights as recorded in A Company’s shareholder register, seeks to elect D as a director upon the expiration of the terms of directors B and C of A Company. Which of the following statements is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: A may make a shareholder proposal to a director, in writing or by electronic document, 6 weeks before the date of the shareholders’ meeting in order to propose “the director election proposal” as an agenda item of the shareholders’ meeting and “the proposal to elect D as a director” as a resolution item of the shareholders’ meeting.
B: If A Company makes the proposed item submitted by A into an item of the shareholders’ meeting, when A makes a request, A Company must give A an opportunity to explain that item at the shareholders’ meeting.
C: Since the director who received A’s proposal must make it an item to be considered at the shareholders’ meeting unless the proposal violates statutes and regulations, it must be made an item to be considered at the shareholders’ meeting even if the proposal violates the articles of incorporation.
D: If A Company convenes a shareholders’ meeting to elect 2 persons among B, C, and D as directors, A may demand of A Company, by written document or electronic document, up to 7 days before the date of the shareholders’ meeting, that the directors be elected by the method of cumulative voting.
E: Even when 2 directors are elected by the method of cumulative voting at A Company’s shareholders’ meeting, the quorum prescribed in the articles of incorporation must still be satisfied.
label: C

question: Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are true (○) and false (×) concerning the acquisition of minority shares by a controlling shareholder under Article 360-24 of the Commercial Act (Right to Demand Sale by a Controlling Shareholder)? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) (a) A controlling shareholder may, where necessary to achieve the company’s managerial purpose, obtain prior approval of the general meeting of shareholders and demand that the minority shareholder sell the shares it holds.
